outputs.content:

- Cotton is named after the makers' real pet kitten: "Three months ago, we released minimi in memory of our pet kitten, Cotton 🐈" [S16](https://www.producthunt.com/products/shram?launch=1255017).
- In the 2.0 framing, Cotton is the AI cat "who remembers," alongside Melody, who handles commitments [S19](https://chatgate.ai/en/post/minimi-2-0#1).

So the inspiration appears to be their own late kitten, Cotton — but that comes from a Product Hunt maker comment, not the official About page.
